headline: Public hearing on proposed ban on data centers in industrial zones, plus Peace Dale Preserve zoning at 371 Rose Hill Road.
summary: The agenda includes a public hearing on proposed zoning changes that would prohibit data centers in industrial zones. It also covers a proposed zoning district at 371 Rose Hill Road, a $169,000 water well field study contract, and several consent agenda items.

Posted on 10/22/2026 
TOWN COUNCIL AGENDA 
 
TOWN OF SOUTH KINGSTOWN 
 
RHODE ISLAND 
 
 
 
Monday, October 26, 2026 
 
CLOSED EXECUTIVE SESSION - 6:30 PM 
REGULAR SESSION - 7:30 PM 
  
Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street 
Wakefield, RI 
 
TOWN COUNCIL 
Rory H. McEntee, President 
Michael K. Marran, Vice President 
Deborah D. Bergner 
Patricia A. Alley 
Jay G. Wegimont 
 
James M. Manni, Town Manager 
Amy H. Goins, Esq., Town Solicitor 
Emily R. Houle, Town Clerk 
 
Members of the public are welcome and encouraged to attend in person or view the meeting live on 
the Town Council YouTube channel or on your local Public Access Television Station.  
 
NOTE:  Individuals requesting American Sign Language interpreters or CART service must call the Town 
Clerk’s Office at 401-789-9331 seventy-two (72) hours in advance of the meeting date.
Posted on 10/22/2026 
1. Closed Executive Session - 6:30 PM 
 A. A Closed Executive Session pursuant to §42-46-5(a)(5) pertaining to discussions 
or considerations related to the acquisition or lease of real property for public 
purposes, or of the disposition of publicly held property wherein advanced public 
information would be detrimental to the interest of the public. 
2. Regular Session - 7:30 PM 
Please be advised that the Council intends to discuss and/or act upon each and every item 
appearing on this agenda. 
 A. Pledge of Allegiance 
 B. Land Acknowledgement Statement 
3. Roll Call 
4. Approval of Minutes of Previous Meetings 
 A. Regular Session - October 13, 2026 
 B. Special Joint Session - October 13, 2026 
5. Interviews 
 A. Charlene Traynum application for reappointment to the Housing Authority of 
South Kingstown 
 B. Paul McConnell nomination for appointment to the Canvassing Authority as the 
Alternate (D) Member 
 C. David Cote nomination for appointment to the Canvassing Authority as the 
Alternate (R) Member 
 D. Steven Stewart application for reappointment to the Saugatucket Veterans' 
Memorial Park Commission 
 E. Joe "Tiger" Patrick application for appointment to the Saugatucket Veterans' 
Memorial Park Commission 
6. Appointments 
 A. A resolution appointing                          to the                         
Board/Committee/Commission for a term to expire                           . 
 B. A resolution appointing                        to the Canvassing Authority as an 
Alternate (R) Member to fill a term to expire March 2027. 
 C. A resolution appointing                        to the Canvassing Authority as an 
Alternate (D) Member. 
7. Consent Agenda
Posted on 10/22/2026 
Rule 13: All items listed with a (CA) are to be considered routine by the Town Council and 
will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless 
a member of the Council, or a member of the public so requests, in which event the item 
will be removed from Consent Agenda (CA) consideration and considered in its normal 
sequence on the agenda. 
(CA) A. A resolution authorizing a contract renewal to CivicPlus, 302 South 4th Street, 
Suite 500, Manhattan, KS 66502 for Website Central in the amount of $12,008.26 
with a 3-year renewal option not to exceed a ten percent (10%) increase over the 
prior year as described in a memorandum from the Director of Technology to the 
Town Manager dated October 13, 2026 and titled, “Website Contract Renewal.” 
(CA) B. A resolution authorizing a contract to Sertex Broadband Solutions, 22 Center 
Parkway, Plainfield, CT 06374 for fiber services in the amount of $19,908.91 with 
a contingency of $3,000 as described in a memorandum from the Director of 
Technology to the Town Manager dated October 13, 2026 and titled “Fiber 
Extension for New High School". 
(CA) C. A resolution authorizing an extension of an award of bid originally granted on 
January 23, 2023, to United Site Services Northeast, Inc., 118 Flanders Road, 
Westborough, MA 01581 for Portable Restroom Services, at the 2026 unit prices 
bid, for the 2027 calendar year, and as further described in a memorandum from 
the Leisure Services Director to the Town Manager dated October 16, 2026 and 
entitled, "Bid Extension Recommendation – Portable Restroom Services." 
(CA) D. A resolution granting the Petition #15080958 of Rhode Island Energy and 
Verizon New England to install pole P15-1 to hold a pole top antenna that is 
currently on P15 on the south side of Narragansett Avenue East, approximately 
367 feet east of Narragansett Avenue East and Peckham Drive intersection, and 
to use the public ways named for the purposes stated in said petition, that the 
work be done to the satisfaction of the Director of Public Services and notification 
to Town for municipal utility mark-out prior to pole setting, and that this approval 
is conditioned upon the removal of all existing double poles along the entire 
length of Narragansett Avenue East prior to new pole(s) placement; and any new 
double poles created as part of this request be removed within sixty (60) calendar 
days of new pole(s) placement. Said petition is further described in a 
memorandum from the Public Services Director to the Town Manager dated 
October 15, 2026 and entitled “Rhode Island Energy Pole Setting Request – Pole 
P15-1 Narragansett Avenue East." 
(CA) E. A resolution granting the Petition #15067474 of Rhode Island Energy and 
Verizon New England to install Joint Pole P3-1 on the south side of School Street 
on Town of South Kingstown property located at 36 School Street (AP 57-1, Lot 
111) for the Union Fire District, Station 3 - Forestry Fire Station Renovation 
Project to provide an underground distribution system over, under, through, 
across, and upon Grantor's Land (see attached easement), that the work be 
done to the satisfaction of the Director of Public Services and notification to the 
Town for municipal utility mark-out prior to pole setting, and that this approval is 
conditioned upon the removal of all existing double poles along the entire length 
of School Street prior to new pole(s) placement; and any new double poles
Posted on 10/22/2026 
created as part of this request be removed within sixty (60) calendar days of new 
pole(s) placement. Said petition is further described in a memorandum from the 
Public Services Director to the Town Manager dated October 21, 2026 and 
entitled, "Rhode Island Energy Pole Setting Request - Pole P3-1 at 36 School 
Street." 
(CA) F. A resolution authorizing the Town Assessor to abate taxes in the amount of 
$5,000.68, as shown on Tax Abatement Request No. 669. 
(CA) G.  A resolution granting Victualling Licenses for the year beginning December 1, 
2026 to the following; Renewals: 
 
Justin Fontaine Restaurants LLC d/b/a Meldgie’s Rivers Edge Café, 406 Main 
Street, Wakefield, RI 02879. Application by Justin Fontaine, Owner. License No. 
90662. 
Justin Fontaine Restaurants LLC d/b/a Arabella’s Coffee House, 406 Main Street, 
Wakefield, RI 02879. Application by Justin Fontaine, Owner. License No. 91159. 
PB PVD SoCo LLC d/b/a Playa Bowls RI, 36 South County Commons Way, 
Wakefield, RI 02879. Application by Michael Walsh, Partner. License No. 89681. 
Coastal Vitality LLC d/b/a The Fresh Monkee, 540 Kingstown Road, Wakefield, 
RI 02879. Application by Andrew Simmons, Owner. License No. 92285. 
(CA) H.  A resolution granting a Shellfish and Farm Produce Peddler License for the year 
beginning December 1, 2026 to Stoney Acres Farm d/b/a Stoney Acres Farm, 
140 Stoney Acres Way, Wakefield, RI 02879. Application by Linda Stedman, Co-
Owner. Renewal; License No. 59131. 
(CA) I. A resolution granting a Farm Retail Sales License for the year beginning 
December 1, 2026, to Wicked Rhody LLC d/b/a Wicked Rhody, West Kingston, 
RI 02892. Application by Brian Hallene, Managing Member. Renewal; License 
No. 94411. 
(CA) J. A resolution granting a Tourist Accommodations License for the year beginning 
December 1, 2026 to Sheppard’s Campus Bed & Breakfast d/b/a Sheppard’s 
Campus Bed & Breakfast,16 Campus Avenue, Wakefield, RI 02879. Application 
by David Sheppard, Owner. Renewal; License No. 61883. 
(CA) K. A resolution authorizing the Town Clerk to advertise for Order of Notice a Public 
Hearing relative to an application for renewal of an Indoor Shooting Range 
License in accordance with the South Kingstown Town Code, Chapter 9 Licenses 
and Miscellaneous Business Regulation, Article IV Indoor Shooting Ranges, Sec. 
9-158 Term of License, Renewal. Application by IDGR15, LLC d/b/a Elite Indoor 
Gun Range, by Mark A. Fay, Member for property located at 371 Rose Hill Road, 
Wakefield, RI 02879 and designated as Assessor’s Plat 33, Lot 30, consisting of 
121.57 acres. 
8. Licenses - None
Posted on 10/22/2026 
9. Public Comment - 30 Minutes 
Rule 10A. for the conduct of the meetings of the South Kingstown Town Council: Members 
of the public shall be entitled to speak at regular meetings during any period designated on 
the agenda for public comment, once, for a period of five minutes, or longer at the 
discretion of the President, and at other times when invited to do so by the President. The 
public shall address their comments to the question under debate as indicated on the 
agenda. Pursuant to RI General Laws §42-46-6(b), public comment regarding subject 
matter not on the agenda but received during the public participation portion of a meeting 
shall be for information purposes only and may not be voted on except where necessary to 
address an unexpected occurrence that requires immediate action to protect the public or 
to refer the matter to an appropriate committee or to another body or official. 
10. Public Hearings 
 A. A Public Hearing to consider proposed amendments to the Town's Zoning 
Ordinance, Article 3. Use Regulations, Section 301. Schedule of Use Regulations 
Table., Appendix A. Use Code Descriptions, to prohibit data centers in Industrial 
Zones, as requested by Council Vice President Marran, as attached. 
11. New Business 
 A. A resolution amending the charge of the Saugatucket Veterans' Memorial Park 
Commission to provide for broader requirements for board membership, as 
detailed in a memorandum from the Town Clerk to the Town Manager. 
 B. A resolution authorizing the Town Clerk to advertise for Order of Notice a Public 
Hearing relative to adoption of the update to the Town of South Kingstown 
Harbor Management Plan dated July 2026, a copy of which is viewable on the 
Town's website at: 
https://www.southkingstownri.gov/DocumentCenter/View/23302/Draft-Harbor-
Management-Plan_July-2026 or in the Office of the Town Clerk. 
 C. A resolution authorizing the Town Clerk to advertise for Order of Notice to 
consider proposed amendments to the Zoning Ordinance, Appendix A, to 
establish the Peace Dale Preserve Special Management District. The property is 
identified as 371 Rose Hill Road, and further described as Tax Assessor’s Map 
33, Lot 30. Petition filed by Applicant/Owner BWJW, LLC. 
 D. A resolution authorizing the Town Manager to execute a grant agreement with 
the Department of Health and Human Services – Health Resources and Services 
Administration for funding for on ambulance and equipment, as further described 
in a memorandum from the Chief of EMS to the Town Manager dated October 7, 
2026, and entitled “Ambulance Grant Acceptance – Health Resources and 
Services Administration." 
 E. A resolution authorizing the Town Manager to execute a Subrecipient Agreement 
with Restore America’s Estuaries on behalf of the Town for stormwater related 
work in the Saugatucket River watershed as further detailed in a memorandum 
from the Director of Public Services to the Town Manager, dated October 9, 
2026, entitled "Saugatucket Watershed Flooding and Stormwater Plan, RAE
Posted on 10/22/2026 
Grant Recommendation." 
 F. A resolution authorizing an award to GZA GeoEnvironmental, Inc., 188 Valley 
Street, Suite 300 Providence, RI 02909 for the South Shore Water District 
Factory Pond Well Field Study, in an amount not to exceed $169,000, which 
includes a $35,000 contingency, from the Water Enterprise Fund's Nonoperation 
Expence, PFAS Litigation Holdings, account number 70292090-580150, as 
further described in a purchasing recommendation from the Director of Public 
Service to the Town Manager dated October 15, 2026, regarding, "South Shore 
Water District Factory Pond Well Field Study." 
 G. Discussion and potential action relative to a proposed Town Code Ordinance 
Amendment relating to pool safety covers, as requested by Council Member 
Bergner. 
12. Town Manager's Report 
 A. Update on the Veolia water ban 
 B. SK USA 250th Ad Hoc Committee update 
 C. Update on public communication efforts relating to the local ballot question 
regarding a Town Charter Amendment to Section 4414.4 Police Department 
Rules and Regulations  
13. Public Comments - Continued 
14. Communications 
 A. An email dated August 25, 2026 from James Brangi, continued from September 
14, September 28, and October 13, 2026, requesting that the Town Council 
evaluate regional desalination for long-term water security is received, placed on 
file, and the Town Council further directs                               . 
 B. A letter dated October 2, 2026, continued from October 13, 2026, and an email 
dated October 20, 2026 from Norma Roelke, requesting that the Town Council 
evaluate the Short Term Rental Ordinance are received, placed on file, and the 
Town Council further directs                        . 
 C. An email dated October 13, 2026, from Amy Rousseau requesting to adopt an 
ordinance permitting ASTM-Compliant Pool Safety Covers in Lieu of a Perimeter 
Fence is received, placed on file, and the Town Council further directs                   
   . 
15. Town Council Discussion Items - None
